corner.$description: Corner-radius roles. Named `corner` rather than `radius` because the shadcn bridge already publishes a single `--radius` knob at that path — a group and a leaf cannot share a token path, and the build resolves such a collision silently. These roles reference the Tailwind corner ramp (--radius-*), which is derived from --radius, so retuning that one knob still retunes every role. Fixed shapes alias the primitive scale directly.

base.$description: The white-label corner knob. Published unprefixed as --radius by the bridge; the Tailwind corner ramp is derived from it, so overriding --radius at runtime retunes every corner role.

xs.$description: A hairline corner (2px) for dense chrome — chart swatches, tooltip arrows. Fixed rather than ramp-derived: at this size the ramp would round it away.

sm.$description: A small fixed corner (4px) for controls that must stay squarer than the ramp — the checkbox box.
